mutations.name: a one-PR round's Ship button reads Ship it
kills: a question round shows a ship question with no images as the Ship view, its recommendation shown and no image section

mutations.name: the round keys fire with a modifier held
kills: a question round ignores a digit pressed with a modifier

mutations.name: the Invalid group opens by default
kills: the rounds list folds invalid rounds into their own group, closed until pressed, each reason cut to one line

mutations.name: an empty group shows the loud empty-state heading
kills: the rounds list shows an empty group as one muted line, not an empty-state heading
